title: Keep procedure active until living report finalizes
description:
As an operator, I want a retryable living-report publication state to keep its procedure active, so that the authoritative Report cannot remain behind a falsely completed procedure.

Feature: Retryable living-report publication
Scenario: Publication must be retried before procedure completion
  Given a portfolio run has completed analysis
  And publishing the next durable Report revision returns a retryable running state
  When the Tactus procedure evaluates the portfolio-run result
  Then the procedure remains active for replay
  And it does not mark the procedure completed
  And it does not advance to a terminal finalization stage

Scenario: Terminal completion requires an authoritative final Report revision
  Given a portfolio run reaches a terminal decision
  When the Tactus procedure completes
  Then the linked Report contains a terminal finalization revision
  And the Report and Procedure show consistent terminal status

Out of scope: client-specific findings, automatic score changes, champion promotion, and new backend resources.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Production dogfooding reproduced the contract violation: a retryable running result from living-report publication was treated as terminal by the outer procedure, leaving the Report at a nonterminal milestone while the Procedure completed. Writing an outside-in runtime contract test before changing control flow.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementing the Plexus side of native scheduled continuation: preserve Tactus WAITING_FOR_TIME across the runner, executor, durable Procedure/Task metadata, dispatcher, and resume service; add fail-closed boundary coverage without schema changes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Native scheduled-continuation integration is now green across the checked-in portfolio procedure. Added append-only replay coverage for two consecutive publication retries, stable run identity, pending-checkpoint recovery, and local dispatcher preservation of WAITING_FOR_TIME. Red proof caught early execution and false completion before the fixes. Current focused evidence: 114 runner/executor/resume/dispatcher/config tests passed and 421 portfolio/report/optimizer/rubric tests passed; no new backend resources.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Final read-only review found and red tests reproduced three additional safety gaps. Fixed checkpoint loading to require the exact Tactus replay boundary at replay_index minus one, fixed WAITING_FOR_CHILDREN so TaskStages remain resumable rather than failed, and added distinct Procedure-first scheduled-wait crash recovery coverage. Revalidated 117 focused Plexus runtime tests, 156 focused Tactus tests, 421 portfolio/report tests, and both repository diff checks.
